europe_now.title: Violent Protests in Germany
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations concerning the cost of living in Germany escalated into violent clashes and looting, prompting heightened security responses. The unrest underscores growing public discontent and economic pressures across the region.

sources.headline: 'Gen Z' demonstrations across Germany demand more education funding

top_stories.title: Widespread Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators participated in widespread protests across France over multiple consecutive weeks. Authorities deployed significant security measures to manage escalating disorder and demonstrations.

sources.headline: Some 320,000 demonstrators take part in largely peaceful protests across France
Hundreds of thousands of protesters march across France for third week in a row

top_stories.title: Humanitarian Evacuations from Occupied Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Civilians evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky arrived in Ukraine after enduring years of severe hardship in frontline areas. The arrivals experienced emotional reunions with their families following successful humanitarian operations.

sources.headline: Emotional reunions with loved ones for Oleshky evacuees

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Tensions Over Russia at G20
top_stories.summary: European officials warned that a potential return of Vladimir Putin to the G20 risks normalizing Russian war crimes. Meanwhile, ministers remained deeply divided over Russia's presence at international diplomatic gatherings.
